arxiv-2110-06978.title: WAFFLE : Weighted Averaging for Personalized Federated Learning
arxiv-2110-06978.creator: Martin Beaussart, Felix Grimberg, Mary-Anne Hartley, Martin Jaggi
arxiv-2110-06978.description: Abstract In federated learning, model personalization can be a very effective strategy to deal with heterogeneous training data across clients. We introduce WAFFLE (Weighted Averaging For Federated LEarning), a personalized collaborative machine learning algorithm that leverages stochastic control variates for faster convergence.

arxiv-2308-00461.title: Non-invasive in silico determination of ventricular wall pre-straining and characteristic cavity pressures
arxiv-2308-00461.creator: Sebastian Skatulla, Carlo Sansour, Mary Familusi, Jagir Hussan, Ntobeko Ntusi
arxiv-2308-00461.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sebastian Skatulla, Carlo Sansour, Mary Familusi, Jagir Hussan, Ntobeko Ntusi. The clinical application of patient-specific modelling of the heart can provide valuable insights in supplementing and advancing methods of diagnosis as well as helping to devise the best possible therapeutic approach for each individual pathological heart condition.

arxiv-2312-05827.title: Detecting Toxic Flow Journal: TBA
arxiv-2312-05827.creator: Álvaro Cartea, Gerardo Duran-Martin, Leandro Sánchez-Betancourt
arxiv-2312-05827.description: Abstract This paper develops a framework to predict toxic trades that a broker receives from her clients. Toxic trades are predicted with a novel online Bayesian method which we call the projection-based unification of last-layer and subspace estimation (PULSE). PULSE is a fast and statistically-efficient online procedure to train a Bayesian neural network sequentially.

arxiv-2312-17367.title: Factorizing two-loop vacuum sum-integrals
arxiv-2312-17367.creator: Andrei I. Davydychev, Pablo Navarrete, and York Schröder
arxiv-2312-17367.description: Abstract We derive analytic results for scalar massless bosonic vacuum sum-integrals at two loops. Building upon a recent factorization proof of massive two-loop vacuum integrals, we are able to solve the corresponding Matsubara sums and map the result onto one-loop structures, thereby proving factorization also in the sum-integral setting.

arxiv-2410-12985.title: Leveraging LLMs for Translating and Classifying Mental Health Data
arxiv-2410-12985.creator: Konstantinos Skianis, A. Seza Doğruöz, John Pavlopoulos
arxiv-2410-12985.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in medical fields. In mental health support, the early identification of linguistic markers associated with mental health conditions can provide valuable support to mental health professionals, and reduce long waiting times for patients.

arxiv-2505-01418.title: Weyl symmetry in ( D 4 , D 4 ) (D_{4},D_{4}) conformal matter on a circle
arxiv-2505-01418.creator: Xing-Yue Wei
arxiv-2505-01418.description: Abstract We study Weyl symmetry in quadrivalently glued 5-brane webs of rank N N ( D 4 , D 4 ) (D_{4},D_{4}) conformal matter theories on a circle. We find that these theories all have affine E 8 E_{8} Weyl symmetry in their brane webs, which indicates that they all have affine E 8 E_{8} global symmetry.

arxiv-2601-07253.title: Universal Adversarial Purification with DDIM Metric Loss for Stable Diffusion
arxiv-2601-07253.creator: Li Zheng, Liangbin Xie, Jiantao Zhou, He YiMin
arxiv-2601-07253.description: Abstract Stable Diffusion (SD) often produces degraded outputs when the training dataset contains adversarial noise. Adversarial purification offers a promising solution by removing adversarial noise from contaminated data. However, existing purification methods are primarily designed for classification tasks and fail to address SD-specific adversarial strategies, such as attacks targeting the VAE encoder, UNet denoiser, or both.

pmc-11339857.creator: Zhixiong Chen, Ni Hong, Nuo Xu, Cui Yan, Ping Cao, Hong Yao

pmc-11428340.title: Epigenetic mechanisms in cardiovascular complications of diabetes: towards future therapies
pmc-11428340.creator: Giulia Damiano, Raffaella Rinaldi, Angela Raucci, Chiara Molinari, Annalisa Sforza, Sergio Pirola, Francesco Paneni, Stefano Genovese, Giulio Pompilio, Maria Cristina Vinci
pmc-11428340.description: The pathophysiological mechanisms of cardiovascular disease and microvascular complications in diabetes have been extensively studied, but effective methods of prevention and treatment are still lacking. In recent years, DNA methylation, histone modifications, and non-coding RNAs have arisen as possible mechanisms involved in the development, maintenance, and progression of micro- and macro-vascular complications of diabetes.

pmc-11529410.title: De Novo Missense Variations of ATP8B2 Impair Its Phosphatidylcholine Flippase Activity
pmc-11529410.creator: Hiroyuki Takatsu, Narumi Nishimura, Yusuke Kosugi, Haruo Ogawa, Kazuhisa Nakayama, Estelle Colin, Konrad Platzer, Rami Abou Jamra, Silke Redler, Clément Prouteau, Alban Ziegler, Hye-Won Shin
pmc-11529410.description: P4-ATPases comprise a family of lipid flippases that translocate lipids from the exoplasmic (or luminal) to the cytoplasmic leaflet of biological membranes. Of the 14 known human P4-ATPases, ATP8B2 is a phosphatidylcholine flippase at the plasma membrane, but its physiological function is not well understood.

pmc-11814178.title: Application of deep learning for real-time detection, localization, and counting of the malignant invasive weed Solanum rostratum Dunal
pmc-11814178.creator: Shifeng Du, Yashuai Yang, Hongbo Yuan, Man Cheng
pmc-11814178.description: Solanum rostratum Dunal (SrD) is a globally harmful invasive weed that has spread widely across many countries, posing a serious threat to agriculture and ecosystem security. A deep learning network model, TrackSolanum, was designed for real-time detection, location, and counting of SrD in the field. The TrackSolanmu network model comprises four modules: detection, tracking, localization, and counting.

pmc-12581792.title: Immune Landscape in Kidney Transplantation
pmc-12581792.creator: Di Niu, Ruifang Chen, Xinxin Pang
pmc-12581792.description: Kidney transplantation is the optimal treatment for end-stage renal failure patients. However, its long-term survival rate remains relatively low, with immune rejection being a crucial risk factor. In recent years, notable progress has been made in the study of the immune regulation network in kidney transplantation.

pmc-13043002.title: Investigation of Community Behaviors, Socioeconomic Factors, and Breakthrough COVID-19 Infections Among Vaccinated Individuals: Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13043002.creator: Matthew J McDonald, Bathri Narayan Vajravelu
pmc-13043002.description: BackgroundDespite widespread COVID-19 vaccination, breakthrough infections remain a public health concern, with transmission risks potentially linked to community behaviors and age-specific preventive practices. While mask-wearing and social distancing are well-established mitigation strategies, their adoption patterns across age groups, particularly among vaccinated individuals, are poorly understood.

pmc-13466869.title: Mapping How Objective Structured Clinical Examinations Are Operationalized to Support Student Learning Across Nursing, Nurse Practitioner, and Medical Education: Protocol for a Scoping Review
pmc-13466869.creator: Lisa Creelman, James Lomen, Cheltey Berlinguette, Natalie Boersma, Amy Beck, Giusy Rita Maria La Rosa
pmc-13466869.description: BackgroundObjective structured clinical examinations (OSCEs) are a common assessment tool used to evaluate the application of clinical knowledge, clinical reasoning, competency-based performance, and professional behavior in health care education. Their development and facilitation are often included under the broader umbrella of simulation pedagogies.

pmc-13539646.title: Increased serum amyloid A and urinary kidney injury marker‐1 concentrations in cats with pyelonephritis: a diagnostic accuracy study
pmc-13539646.creator: L. R. Jessen, F. S. Moberg, R. Langhorn, A. S. Gravgaard, N. Dupont, N. Bak‐Jacobsen, B. J. Reezigt, A. L. Jensen, D. Bienzle, L. N. Nielsen
pmc-13539646.description: ObjectivesTo investigate the discriminatory potential of serum amyloid A, neutrophil:lymphocyte ratio, monocyte:lymphocyte ratio and assess renal tubular injury in cats with pyelonephritis.Materials and MethodsDiagnostic accuracy study using samples from prospectively enrolled cats and stored material.
